item.phantomstorage.phantom_charm.toolti: Look at it + Right-click: Swap places
Right-click: Ride your Phantom Chest / get off
Riding: fly where you look with WASD, Space to rise, sprint for speed; sneak to get off
Sneak + Right-click: Dismiss the Phantom Chest
Right-click: Open a gateway to your anchored Phantom Anchor
Right-click: Summon every pet that isn't out
Sneak + Right-click: Dismiss every following pet and close the gateway (anchored pets stay)
sort.phantomstorage.name: Name
tooltip.phantomstorage.trash.desc: Click while holding an item to destroy it
tooltip.phantomstorage.void_slot.desc: Items like these are destroyed when your Phantom Collector picks them up, instead of going into storage. Click with an item to add it; click an entry empty-handed to clear it
tooltip.phantomstorage.result.desc: Shift-click to craft as many as possible
tooltip.phantomstorage.tank_active: Active tank: buckets used on the tank start here
tooltip.phantomstorage.tank_select: Click with an empty cursor: make active
tooltip.phantomstorage.tank_pour: Left-click with a container: pour in
tooltip.phantomstorage.tank_take: Right-click with a container: fill it
tooltip.phantomstorage.tank_trash.desc: Destroys the fluid in this tank
tooltip.phantomstorage.tank_overfill.des: Buckets on the tank: when the active tank is full, fill the next tank of that fluid or an empty one. Off: active tank only
tooltip.phantomstorage.tank_drain_all.de: Buckets on the tank: when the active tank is empty, keep drawing from the next tank until all are empty. Off: active tank only
tooltip.phantomstorage.anchor_stay.desc: On: it stays here, its chunk loaded while you're online. Off: it follows you
tooltip.phantomstorage.anchor_dismiss.de: Sends the anchor away and forgets its spot
Click with an item to add it; click an entry empty-handed to clear it. Empty: it takes everything
tooltip.phantomstorage.collector_skip.de: On: the filter lists what to leave. Off: what to take
tooltip.phantomstorage.collector_range.d: How far it reaches, round you or round its spot: 3 to 12 blocks. Click or scroll
tooltip.phantomstorage.collector_take.de: Experience it collects while it stays somewhere is banked here; following, it goes straight to you
tooltip.phantomstorage.collector_stay.de: On: it collects round this spot, its chunk loaded while you're online, wherever you are. Off: it follows and collects round you
tooltip.phantomstorage.collector_dismiss: Sends the collector away and forgets its spot; its settings and banked experience stay
